text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"CA","level":"state","category":"screening_restrictions","status":"in_force","title":"California FEHA limits on source-of-income and criminal-history screening","requirement":"Housing providers may not refuse to rent based on source of income, including Section 8 Housing Choice vouchers, other rental assistance, SSI, the state COVID-19 Rent Relief Program, or wages. They may not refuse to complete paperwork or provide documents required by a rental assistance or subsidy program, apply different terms such as a higher security deposit to voucher holders, or advertise \"No Section 8.\" For criminal history, providers may not consider arrests that did not lead to a conviction, sealed or expunged records, or juvenile justice records. Blanket bans on applicants with any criminal history are prohibited.
